prediction_point.approval_status: H11 = PENDING_A_REVIEW. Member A has NOT approved. S2 joint approval NOT CONFIRMED.
prediction_point.decision_basis: Early prediction with enough observed history. Reference: proposal P5-A-S2-01 by member A (N=3 preferred) and the H10 session-length distribution. This is a design choice, not the result of an N optimisation.
prediction_point.early_purchase_rule: purchase at or before event selected_n -> session excluded
prediction_point.label_definition: label=1 if a purchase exists with event_idx > selected_n in the session; label=0 otherwise within valid label scope

temporal_policy.assignment: train/validation only if the whole session lies inside the window (session_end < window end)
temporal_policy.censoring: sessions starting in a window but ending after it are counted as censored, not labelled
temporal_policy.invalid_session: NULL or blank user_session: counted as events, not as sessions
temporal_policy.session_time: min(event_time) and max(event_time) over ALL events of the session
temporal_policy.test_range: counted only by session start; never ranked, never labelled

decision_note: Official N comes from config selected_n (design decision by member B). The script never selects N from data. H11 windows remain PENDING_A_REVIEW; member A has not approved.
